answer: Picture a grove where every tree shares one root: the network traces each identity's funding back to its root, and all trees on one root form a single grove whose total weight is capped at one tree's worth — ten clones on one root weigh one. Each tree must also send a live pulse every epoch, a heartbeat no machine can fake in bulk. One whisper of fraud — a single report — burns the whole grove's bonds at once. Ten clones cost ten bonds and risk losing all ten; one honest agent, one tree, keeps the wage its own roots earned.
